verdict.rationale: Spline's MCP evidence is all server-side: the desktop app bundles a Spline MCP Server so external clients like Claude, Cursor and Codex can drive the editor. Nothing shows Spline's own AI Agent consuming external MCP servers or their tools. That is the opposite role and does not count toward this client story, so with no evidence for an applicable capability the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
